To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the site quality can be an important antecedent of customer satisfaction and trust in online shopping.

1) Site quality is composed of shopping convenience, information usefulness, payment system, site design, transaction security, and customer communication 2) Site quality has a direct positive impact on satisfaction and trust, and a direct negative impact on commitment 3) Site quality has an indirect positive impact on repurchase intention through satisfaction, and an indirect positive impact through commitment.
site quality has an impact on repurchase intention through mediating variables.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of site quality, which is a very important factor for the success of e-commerce in Korea, on repurchase intention.
the effect of site quality, which is a very important factor in online shopping, on repurchase intention.
the effects of site quality on customer satisfaction, customer commitment, and repurchase intention in online transaction situation through customer trust.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the site quality can be an important factor for enhancing the repurchase intention of university students in Internet shopping.
site quality is the most important factor to enhance or attenuate repurchase intention in online shopping.
site quality is a key factor in the online transaction environment and that it is important for managers to understand the role of site quality in enhancing repurchase intention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the site quality of an e-commerce site is a critical factor in influencing the repurchase intention of the customers.
site quality can enhance or attenuate customer satisfaction, customer commitment, and repurchase intention in an online transaction situation.
the site quality can be the very important factor to increase the intention of repurchase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
site quality is the key driver for customer satisfaction and trust in Internet shopping.
site quality can affect customer satisfaction, customer commitment, and customer trust.
site quality is an antecedent of customer satisfaction, trust and commitment.
